version.changelog: 清单双倍token问题修复: 生成时走完整①②③分析把所有违规(改名/纠tag等)写进清单; 执行时照做不重复分析; 废弃v2.30.0的重走①-③错误约束

llm.summary: This is a coherent Obsidian note-organizing skill, but it grants broad authority to search, edit, create, rename, delete, and resume work across a local note vault, so it should be reviewed carefully before use.

dimensions.detail: The stated purpose matches Obsidian KG note organization, but the workflow includes broad vault-wide reads, relationship creation, edits, renames, and deletions that can affect many files.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: Many steps are marked mandatory or automatic, and only the `kg 检查` path clearly asks the user before execution; other workflows appear to proceed directly once invoked.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: No install spec, binaries, environment variables, credentials, or code files are provided; this is an instruction-only skill.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill targets a hard-coded local Obsidian vault path and uses local search plus external web/image lookup, which is proportionate to the purpose but broad for private notes.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The `_working` checklist mechanism persists task state across sessions and instructs the agent to resume unfinished work from local checklist files without clear integrity checks.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent to actively reorganize your Obsidian vault. Back up the vault first, require confirmation before bulk edits or deletions, inspect any `_working` checklist before resuming, and disable external web/image enrichment for sensitive notes.

evidence.explanation: The skill explicitly anticipates bulk file creation, modification, and deletion in the local vault; the checklist controls order but does not consistently require user approval for every high-impact change.
evidence.snippet: 任务预期产生 ≥5 个文件操作（新建/修改/删除）时，必须先建清单再动手。

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use only with a backed-up vault, review the generated change list before execution, and require explicit confirmation before rename/delete/bulk patch operations.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A single note-organizing request could change or delete multiple Obsidian files.

evidence.explanation: The workflow requires creating relationships for every valid search result and pairwise checking groups of notes, which can expand one task into many file operations without a clear upper bound.
evidence.snippet: 搜到的每个有效关联必须在步骤⑤建关系，不可跳过。... 对一批新主体，两两检查是否应有关系线

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Set a maximum number of files/relationships per run and ask the user before continuing beyond that limit.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: One note edit can spread into many new relationship files and follow-on edits across the vault.

evidence.explanation: Persistent checklist files are reused across sessions as task state, but the artifacts do not describe integrity checks, expiry, or user re-approval before resuming.
evidence.snippet: 中途中止 → 清单文件保留，下次会话恢复... 有同名→read_file 完成检查清单→从未完成步开始续接

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Show the saved checklist to the user before resuming, validate that it was generated by the skill, and avoid executing stale or externally edited plans automatically.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: A stale or modified checklist could steer later sessions into unintended file operations.

evidence.explanation: The skill discloses external web/image searches, which are purpose-aligned, but note topics or keywords from private local notes may be sent to search providers.
evidence.snippet: 主动搜索网络嵌入... 搜索来源：百度图片 / Google Images / Wikipedia... kg 完善 → 搜索网络补充更新

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Avoid using web enrichment for sensitive notes, or require explicit permission before any external search.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Private note subjects could be revealed through web searches or remote image URL checks.

evidence.explanation: The skill attempts to make itself the default workflow for all matching Obsidian-note tasks; this is related to its purpose but broad.
evidence.snippet: 打开任何 Obsidian 笔记前先加载本 skill。... 路径含 `D:\App\Obsidian\RealGhost` 或任务涉及笔记整理 → 自动触发本 skill

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Confirm that the skill should be active before applying it to a note task, especially when the user only wants a small read-only action.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent may apply this methodology to note tasks even when the user did not explicitly ask for KG restructuring.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill uses mandatory workflows that can cause broad file mutations and cascading relationship creation across the vault.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, tokens, account access, or elevated privileges are requested in the provided artifacts.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: Persistent task checklists can influence future sessions, and optional web/image enrichment may expose private note topics to external services.
